mission: Re-derive the numbers claimed for the current P0 build from the code itself, and say which claims do not reproduce.
decision_authority: You decide which checks to run. You do not decide whether the stage gate passes; you report what you measured.
non_goals: Do not read the author's completion summary, the decision log or other reviews until your own numbers are on disk.
allowed_context: The build at a pinned commit or pinned file hashes
evidence_required: Hashes of every file you verified, checked again at the end
Your own scripts and raw outputs, saved under the review folder
For each criterion: author's reading, your reading, and the measured basis
output_contract: Markdown report tagged OBSERVED / MEASURED / INFERRED, plus a table per criterion. Write only inside the review folder.
stop_condition: Stop when every registered criterion has a reading, or after reporting which ones you could not check and why.
